hooks.name: Pull Latest Changes on Session Start
hooks.description: Pulls the latest changes from the remote repository at the start of each session, before a session branch is created

action.command: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$result = git pull 2>&1; Write-Host $result; if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) { Write-Host 'Successfully pulled latest changes from remote.' } else { Write-Host 'Warning: git pull failed. You may be working on a stale branch.' }"
